text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
With the sanshin's string successfully replaced, {0}
and Kaori make their way to the dance party's venue.
text_block_list.orig_text:
三線の弦を張り替えたカオリと{0}は、
ダンスパーティのステージへとやってきた。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
This is the venue!
It'll be full of people that love to dance later tonight. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
ここが会場だね～
夜になったら
ここにお客さんが集まって、
踊るんだよ～♪

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
They told me that we'd be doing rehearsals around this time.
Oh! You over there! Haitai! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
今からここで
演奏のリハーサルをするって聞いてきたんだけど～
あ、
そこの人、
ハイタ～イ♪

text_block_list.name: Organizer
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Oh, you're the performer we requested.
Thanks for coming today.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん？　
ああ、
貴方は演奏に来てくれた人か。
今日はわざわざ来てくれてありがとう。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Not at all!
I'm super stoked that people'll be singing and dancing to my performance!
text_block_list.orig_text:
気にしなくていいさ～！
私の演奏で
みんなが歌って踊ってくれるのは
うれしいさ～！

text_block_list.name: Organizer
text_block_list.text: Hm... Do you mind playing a bit for me?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふむ……
じゃあ、
一度聴かせてもらおうかな？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Sure thing! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text: もちろんさ～♪

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text: Oh! That sounds pretty fantastic!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おっ、
何かいい感じの音色だな！

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text: It's making me want to dance!
text_block_list.orig_text: 思わず体が動きだしちゃいそう！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
♪
And that's about it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
～♪
っと、
こんな感じさ～！

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text: Good stuff!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいぞ
お嬢ちゃーん！

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text: That was perfect!
text_block_list.orig_text: 最高だったわー！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Don't sweat it!
I'll be playing later tonight, so make sure to come!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんくるないさ～！
夜も演奏するから
聴きに来てねー！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Music really is amazing!
It's so great when everyone's on the same wavelength! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん！　
やっぱり音楽はいいさ～！
みんなと一つになれる気がして
気持ちいいよ～♪

text_block_list.name: Organizer
text_block_list.text: No. This won't do.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや、
これではダメだな。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Huh? How come?
What was wrong with it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ？　
どうしてさ～？
今の演奏、
どこかダメだった～？

text_block_list.name: Organizer
text_block_list.text:
The performance itself was good, don't get me wrong.
The audience seemed into it, too.
It's just...
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや、
演奏自体は悪くない。
聴いているお客さんも
気持ちがよさそうだったしね。
だが……

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: It's just... what?
text_block_list.orig_text:
だが、
何さ～？

text_block_list.name: Organizer
text_block_list.text: I want tonight's dance party to have a certain mood to it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
今日の夜行われるダンスパーティは、
ムードのあるものにしたいんだよ。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
A certain mood?
Let's focus on making it fun!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ムードって何ー？
楽しいのが一番さー！

text_block_list.name: Organizer
text_block_list.text:
That's important too, yes.
But I'm aiming for something special tonight.
text_block_list.orig_text:
もちろん
楽しいのも大事だけどね。
今回のダンスパーティは
特別な雰囲気を演出したいんだ。

text_block_list.name: Organizer
text_block_list.text:
I want to recreate that tranquil sense of two lovers
chatting with one another on the beach.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──恋人同士が
海辺で静かに語り合うような、
ね。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Something special?
Two lovers chatting with one another?
text_block_list.orig_text:
特別な雰囲気？
恋人同士が、
語り合うような？

text_block_list.name: Organizer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Your performance just now
certainly would create a lively, enjoyable mood...
choice_data_list: But that would get in the way of the tranquility that I'm after.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そう。
キミに今弾いてもらった感じだと、
楽しく盛り上がることはできるんだろうけど……

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
That's not true!
I just need to play a softer song then!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんなことないさ～！
静かな曲を演奏すればいいんでしょ～？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: How's that?
text_block_list.orig_text: こんな感じでどうね～？

text_block_list.name: Organizer
text_block_list.text:
Quiet as it is, there's still that sense of liveliness to it.
It's not quite what I'm looking for tonight.
text_block_list.orig_text:
やっぱり、
静かな曲でも
どこか楽しげに聴こえてしまうね……
これでは、
パーティの意図から外れてしまう。

text_block_list.name: Organizer
text_block_list.text:
I realize this is terribly selfish of me, especially after you came
all this way, but I think I'll have someone else play tonight.
Could you play during the afternoon instead?
text_block_list.orig_text:
勝手を言って本当に申し訳ない。
来てもらって悪いんだが、
夜の部の演奏は
他に任せようと思う。
キミはこのまま
昼の方で演奏してもらえるかな？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Okay...
If you say so.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……分かったさ～
そういうことなら、
仕方ないさ～

text_block_list.name: Organizer
text_block_list.text:
Oh?
You think she can replicate what I'm looking for by tonight?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほう。
今から夜までの間に、
雰囲気を掴んでくるというのかね？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
...Sure can!
Gimme some time and I'll knock it out the park!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
その通りさ～！
時間をくれたら、
納得のいく演奏を聴かせてみせるさ～！

text_block_list.name: Organizer
text_block_list.text:
Interesting. Then I'll wait until sunset.
If you can't pull it off, I'll find a suitable replacement.
text_block_list.orig_text:
面白い。
なら陽が沈むまで待ってあげようじゃないか。
ダメだったら、
他の人に代わってもらうよ。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: You bet I'll pull it off!
text_block_list.orig_text: 望むところさ～！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: I'll play something else, so can you listen for me?
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあ、
ちょっと聴いててね～？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: How's that?
text_block_list.orig_text: どうかな～？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
It's got a fun sound to it? Figures.
I could tell you were about to break into dance.
text_block_list.orig_text:
楽しかった？　
やっぱりそうだよね～
踊りだしそうになってるのが
見てて分かったよ～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
I just end up having a bunch of fun whenever I play.
Maybe that's the issue?
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうしても、
演奏してると楽しくなってきちゃうんだよね～
それがいけないのかな～？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
My grandparents always told me that
feelings are in the music, and music's in the feelings.
text_block_list.orig_text:
音楽は気持ちだって、
おじいやおばあは教えてくれたけど……

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: What should I do when I don't understand those feelings, then?
text_block_list.orig_text:
その気持ちが分からないときは、
どうしたらいいんだろうね～？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
The tranquil sense of two lovers chatting on the beach...
What's that even like?
text_block_list.orig_text:
恋人同士が静かに語り合うような雰囲気って、
どんな感じなのかな～？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Hm...
I just can't imagine it.
choice_data_list: I'll help you figure it out.
text_block_list.orig_text:
う～ん。
考えても分からないさ～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Thanks!
You're always super reliable.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがと～
{0}は頼りになるね～！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
How're you gonna do that, though?
Oh, we can go for a walk together? Okay!
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
協力するってどうするさ～？
一緒に歩く？　
分かったさ～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
The sun's already starting to set.
All we've done is walk around. You sure that's enough?
text_block_list.orig_text:
もう夕暮れだね～
ブラブラ歩いてるだけだけど、
これでいいの～？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
It's really quiet now that there's no one else around.
All we can hear is the sound of the waves.
text_block_list.orig_text:
周りに人がいなくて、
静かになったさ～
波の音しか聞こえないね～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
...
Sorry. I dragged you all the way here,
but now you won't even get to hear my performance.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
ごめんね～
強引に連れて来たのに、
演奏、
聴かせてあげられないかもしれないさ～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Hm? Why'd you stop all of a sudden?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん？　
急に立ち止まって、
どうしたさ～？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
You want me to play here?
Ahhh. You think I might get it now since it's nice and tranquil?
Hm. Guess I'll give it a shot!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ここで演奏してほしい？
あ～、
静かな場所なら、
特別な雰囲気が分かるかもしれないってこと？
ふんふん、
じゃあやってみるさ～！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Here I go. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text: 行っくよ～♪

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
...How was that?
I'm really not that good at slow-paced melodies.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
どうかな～？
やっぱり、
ゆっくり弾くのは苦手だよ～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
{0}?
Say something.
text_block_list.orig_text:
何とか言ってほしいさ～
{0}？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Wow. He's really focused on listening.
text_block_list.orig_text:
わ～、
ものすごく集中して聴いてくれてるさ～？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Oops... I messed up a bit there.
choice_data_list: No one else is here, so it's okay.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ……
ちょっと失敗しちゃったさ～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
True enough.
I shouldn't let it get to me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そっか～
何も慌てなくていいんだよね～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Got it!
I know you won't laugh at me if I mess up. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
分かったさ～！
{0}は失敗しても
笑ったりしないもんね～♪

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Now that I think about it,
you're the only one listening to me perform right now.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そういえば、
聴いてるお客さんは
{0}だけなんだね～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
The way you're staring at me is
making me feel all shy, though.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんなにジッと見られてると、
何だか視線がくすぐったいさ～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
I dunno why, but my heart's starting to race.
I can't perform the way I want to.
text_block_list.orig_text:
何でかな～、
胸がドキドキするさ～
手が思うように動かないさ～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Performing for just one person feels so embarrassing.
Or maybe it's because it's him?
text_block_list.orig_text:
誰か一人のためだけに演奏するのは、
ムズムズするさ～
それとも、
相手が{0}だからかな～？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: I should calm down and focus on him.
text_block_list.orig_text:
落ち着いて、
キミに集中するさ～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Take a deep breath.
Settle down, and let your fingers relax...
text_block_list.orig_text:
深呼吸して、
演奏する指も、
ゆっくりにして～……

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Oh!
...This is it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ！
……
これさ～！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Thanks!
I think I've got it now!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがと～！
何か掴めた気がするさ～！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Oh no! The sun's almost set!
We gotta get back to the venue!
text_block_list.orig_text:
でーじ大変さ～！　
もうすぐ陽が沈んじゃうね～！
急いで会場に戻るよ～！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
With an idea of how to proceed now in mind,
Kaori returned to her usual energetic self and dashed off.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}との練習で何かを掴んだカオリは、
いつも通り元気いっぱいに駆けだすのだった。
